summary: Small sealed car park in bushland off a park road, no homes near.

best_section.where: Sealed car park at the ring, just south of the small amenity building

drivers.seclusion: Wooded hillside on all sides; the only building within 100 m is a small non-residential block 7 m north.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed bays with a way in from the park road to the south-east; no gate mapped or seen; room for several vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Quiet park road; the Western Freeway is further north-west behind the hill.
drivers.convention: No vehicles parked in either image; an official car park for the park or lookout.

flags: Pin sits on the car park's north edge at a steep bank; ground drops 5-9 m east and west
Possible after-hours closure not visible from above
sun_shade: Tall trees shade the car park from the north and west; open to the south-east.
